abilities.name: Sadism (Trait)
abilities.description: Alarak's Ability damage and self-healing are increased by 100% against enemy Heroes. Repeatable Quest Takedowns increase Sadism by 3%, up to 30%. Sadism gained from Takedowns is lost on death.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Healing dealt modifier
fields.notes: Benefits all flat Spell Damage and healing instances and bonuses from Alarak's Basic and Heroic Abilities and Talents. Spell Damage and healing from other sources will not be amplified. Sadism stacks additively with itself and other damage modifiers affecting Alarak's Ability damage. Sadism stacks additively with healing modifiers that increase healing dealt and multiplicatively with modifiers that affect healing received.

abilities.name: Discord Strike
abilities.description: After a 0.5 second delay, enemies in front of Alarak take 165 damage and are silenced for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.description: Create a force, pushing Alarak and all enemies hit from the targeted point towards the targeted direction. Deals 48 damage to enemies.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Crowd control
fields.notes: Alarak does not get Dazed when using Telekinesis on himself. Self-casting sets the starting point at Alarak's location and pushes him (and nearby enemies) to the direction he is facing.

abilities.name: Lightning Surge
abilities.description: Deal 62 damage to an enemy and an additional 100% damage to enemies between Alarak and the target. Restore 75 Health for each Hero hit.

fields.notes: The primary target of the cast is unaffected by any center bonuses. Healing is unaffected by center bonuses. The center bonus stacks additively with Sadism and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Lightning Surge 's damage.

abilities.name: Deadly Charge
abilities.description: After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 damage to all enemies in his path. Distance is increased based on the amount of time channeled, up to 1.5 seconds. Issuing a Move order while this is channeling will cancel it at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.; 45; 60; Heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Weak Channel (stationary)
fields.notes: Interrupting the channel in any way does not put the Ability on cooldown. Mana cost is not consumed until the Ability has been fully cast, but can't be initiated if Alarak has insufficient Mana. Range increases by 0.6354 for every 0.0625 seconds channeled. Ability can be channeled indefinitely, but distance will no longer increase after reaching maximum distance at the 1.5 second mark.

abilities.name: Counter-Strike
abilities.description: Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. Afterward, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 damage.; 30; 50; Heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Protected, Stationary channel, Unstoppable
fields.notes: Hitscan is done in 3 ticks over 0.1825 seconds, ranging from 0 to 6 on the first, 6 to 9 on the second and 9 to 13 on the third tick. Taking damage in the final tick of the channel only activates the sound, but not the damage, of the Ability. Incoming Basic Attacks still trigger the Ability, despite missing due to Evasion granted by Protected status.

talents.name: Overwhelming Power
talents.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 40% Attack Speed and causes Basic Attacks to heal for 15% of the damage dealt, increased by 50% of Sadism's bonus when hitting Heroes. These effects last for 4 seconds.
_raw_fields: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 40% Attack Speed and causes Basic Attacks to heal for 15% of the damage dealt, increased by 50% of Sadism's bonus when hitting Heroes. These effects last for 4 seconds.

talents.name: Ruthless Momentum
talents.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Telekinesis from 30 to 20. Telekinesis's cooldown recharges 100% faster while above 80% Health.
_raw_fields: Reduce the Mana cost of Telekinesis from 30 to 20. Telekinesis's cooldown recharges 100% faster while above 80% Health.

talents.name: Extended Lightning
talents.description: Reduce Sadism by 10%. Quest Hit Heroes with the center of Lightning Surge. After hitting 5 Heroes, increase Lightning Surge's range by 20%. Reward After hitting 15 Heroes, Lightning Surge's center also Slows enemies by 40% for 2 seconds. Reward After hitting 3 Heroes with a single cast, increase Sadism by 10% and instantly gain all other Rewards.

Reward After hitting 2 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 60. Reward After hitting 3 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 100 and instantly gain all other Rewards.

talents.name: Negatively Charged
talents.description: Increase the Lightning Surge damage bonus to enemies between Alarak and his victim to 175%. Repeatable Quest Each Hero hit by the center of Lightning Surge permanently increases the damage bonus by 5%.

fields.notes: Quest reward stacks additively with center damage bonus and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Lightning Surge 's damage.

talents.name: Show of Force
talents.description: Heroes hit with 3 of Alarak's Abilities within 2 seconds take an additional 61 damage and increase Sadism by 2%, stacking up to 20%. Sadism gained from Show of Force is lost on death.

talents.name: Pure Malice
talents.description: Increase Sadism by 10% any time an allied Hero dies, up to 40%. Sadism gained from Pure Malice is lost on death.
_raw_fields: Increase Sadism by 10% any time an allied Hero dies, up to 40%. Sadism gained from Pure Malice is lost on death.

talents.name: Rite of Rak'Shir
talents.description: Cooldown 300 Activate to mark an enemy Hero for 300 seconds. Hitting the marked Hero with Discord Strike increases Sadism by 3%. Killing the marked Hero increases Sadism by 5% and lowers the cooldown of Rite of Rak'Shir to 10 seconds. Sadism gained from Rite of Rak'Shir is lost on death.

fields.notes: Debuff is only removed when the mark expires or the target dies.

talents.name: Lethal Onslaught
talents.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 50% of Sadism's damage bonus to Alarak's Basic Attacks for 4 seconds. Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh this duration.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Alarak's Basic Attack damage.

talents.name: Lightning Barrage
talents.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with the center of Lightning Surge allows it to be cast again for free on a different primary target within the next 3 seconds. This free cast cannot benefit from Lightning Barrage.

fields.notes: Second cast interacts with all other talents affecting Lightning Surge.

talents.name: Mocking Strikes
talents.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Alarak's Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds. This bonus is doubled against enemy Heroes who are Stunned, Silenced, Slowed or Rooted.

talents.name: Wrath of the Highlord
talents.description: If Deadly Charge was the selected Heroic, Heroes hit by Deadly Strike take bonus damage from Alarak's Abilities equal to 75% of Sadism's bonus damage for 4 seconds. If Counter-Strike was the selected Heroic, it's cooldown is reduced by 2.5 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by Alarak's Basic Abilities.

talents.name: Might of the Highlord
talents.description: Alarak gains access to both of his Heroic Abilities. This can be activated to change which Ability occupies the Heroic slot, with the other ability using the Trait slot.

talents.name: Last Laugh
talents.description: Cooldown 30 Active Activate to teleport to the chosen location and remove all Roots, Slows, and damage over time effects. If Alarak fails to hit enemy Heroes 3 times with Basic Abilities within 4 seconds of using Last Laugh, his Health is reduced to 1.

fields.notes: Hit requirement is the sum of all Heroic targets hit, with any of his Basic Ablities, within the time limit. Health reduction ignores all damage reduction and prevention effects.

talents.name: Hasty Bargain
talents.description: Cooldown 20 Active Activate to permanently reduce Alarak's Sadism by 4% and reset the cooldowns of his Basic Abilities.

fields.notes: Hasty Bargain cannot be used if Alarak doesn't have enough Sadism. Alarak's innate Sadism is consumed first. If there is not enough innate Sadism, Hasty Bargain can consume Sadism gained from Takedowns and Talents.
